LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.title: Librarian · Combat tutorial
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.ask:
New to the Librarian? Try a short combat tutorial to learn how the Orbs work.

Play cards and end turns yourself. You can leave anytime; practice keeps your regular save and records no win or loss.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.compact_ask:
You have won with the Librarian. Use compact hover tips?

Hide nested basics: Activate, Settle, Extinguish, Foreground and Background. Direct card tips, core mechanics and vanilla keywords stay visible.

Change this anytime in RitsuLib → Librarian.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.page1:
You have [gold]Fire, Tide and Growth Orbs[/gold]. The number on each Orb is its current value, which lasts for the combat.

[gold]Fire[/gold] Orb: When settled, deal damage equal to its value to a random enemy.
[gold]Tide[/gold] Orb: When settled, gain Block and Waves equal to its value.
[gold]Growth[/gold] Orb: When settled, increase the lowest-valued other Orb's value by the Growth Orb's value.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.page2:
[gold]Fire / Tide / Growth X[/gold]: Increase the corresponding Orb value by X, then [gold]Activate[/gold] it.

[gold]Activate[/gold] makes an Orb active and moves it to the foremost movable position. Above the character is the [gold]Foreground[/gold]; the sides are the [gold]Background[/gold].

At end of turn, active, unlocked Orbs settle top → left → right, then Extinguish. The Foreground has full effect; the Background has half effect, rounded down. Settling or Extinguishing does not clear the value.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.page3:
[gold]Waves[/gold]: At end of your turn, top up Block from this end-of-turn Tide settlement to your Waves before end of turn. Then halve Waves.

Example: With 15 Waves, if Tide gives 10 Block, Waves add 5 for a total of 15. Block from Tide and Waves lasts until the end of your next turn.

[gold]Lock[/gold]: Extinguish an Orb and prevent it from being Activated or Settled. Its value can still increase while locked. The lock status appears beside the Orb.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.page4:
The [gold]bottom card[/gold] is the bottommost card of your Draw Pile. Read Backward and Fuel the Fire automatically play it for no Energy with a random target. Its own keywords, such as Exhaust, still apply. X-cost cards use your current Energy for X.

An [gold]extra settlement[/gold] triggers an Orb effect, counts as Foreground and does not Extinguish it.

Hover over cards, powers and Orbs to read their explanations. In [gold]RitsuLib → Librarian[/gold], you can replay this tutorial or switch compact hover tips.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.compact_hover_tips_hi: Omit nested basic explanations. Keep directly relevant tips, core mechanics and vanilla keywords.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.character_tutorial_hi: Start the practice run from the main menu. Your regular save is kept.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.menu_required: Start the single-player practice from the main menu. Your ordinary run save is kept.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step0:
[gold]Fire[/gold] deals damage. [gold]Tide[/gold] grants Block and Waves. [gold]Growth[/gold] raises another Orb's value. The numbers show their values.

This fixed-seed lesson uses a fixed enemy and deck. It keeps your saved run and records no win or loss.

Play [gold]Spark[/gold] first.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step1_title: Activation readies an Orb for settlement
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step1:
[gold]Spark[/gold] raised Fire by 5 and activated it.

[gold]Activation[/gold] readies an Orb and moves it to the foremost available position. Above your character is the foreground; the sides are the background.

Play [gold]Trickle[/gold] and watch Tide move.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step1_result:
Fire is now [gold]{Fire}[/gold] and [gold]{FireState}[/gold].

Active Orbs settle at the end of your turn. Fire deals damage to a random enemy when it settles.

This practice has one enemy so the result is easy to follow.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_task1: Play [gold]Trickle[/gold] and watch Tide move above your character.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step2_title: Full effect in front, half in the background
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step2:
Tide has moved to the [gold]foreground[/gold]; Fire is in the background.

At turn end, active and unlocked Orbs settle in top → left → right order. The foreground has full effect; background effects are halved, rounding down.

Press [gold]End Turn[/gold] yourself.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_task2: Press the highlighted [gold]End Turn[/gold] and watch the Orbs and enemy act.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step3_title: Values remain; Waves extend your defense
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step3:
Both Orbs have extinguished, but their values remain. At the new turn, your Relic increased the foreground Tide Orb's value by 1.

[gold]Waves[/gold] top up Block from Tide this turn to your pre-end-turn Waves amount, then halve.

Play another [gold]Trickle[/gold].
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_task3: Play [gold]Trickle[/gold] again to raise and reactivate Tide.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step4:
[gold]Springwater[/gold] immediately gives Tide an Extra Settlement.

[gold]Extra Settlement[/gold] uses the full foreground effect and does not extinguish the Orb.

Play [gold]Springwater[/gold] and watch Block and Waves rise immediately.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step4_result:
Tide is [gold]{Tide}[/gold] · {TideState}.

This Extra Settlement will grant [gold]{Tide} Block and Waves[/gold].

You currently have [gold]{Waves} Waves[/gold]. Compare it with the result after playing the card.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step5_title: An extra effect does not replace turn-end settlement
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step5:
Tide is still [gold]active[/gold]. The Extra Settlement did not extinguish it, so it can still settle normally at turn end.

Now play [gold]Spark[/gold] to put Fire in front and compare Tide in the background.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step5_result:
Tide: [gold]{Tide}[/gold] · {TideState}
Waves: [gold]{Waves}[/gold]

Settlement did not consume Tide’s value.

Repeated settlement and persistent values are both useful when building your deck.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_task5: Play [gold]Spark[/gold] to move Fire to the foreground.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step6_title: Change the foreground, change the outcome
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step6:
Fire is now in front and Tide is in the background.

Tide’s normal settlement is halved, but your stored [gold]Waves[/gold] still top up Block from Tide this turn.

Press [gold]End Turn[/gold] to see the result.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step6_result:
Foreground Fire: [gold]{Fire} damage[/gold]
Background Tide: [gold]{TideHalf} Block and Waves[/gold]

Pre-end-turn Waves: [gold]{Waves}[/gold]

Waves halve after topping up. This does not halve the Orb’s value.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_task6: Press [gold]End Turn[/gold] and compare the new foreground and background effects.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step7:
[gold]Tidal Gravity[/gold] grants 2 Energy and locks Tide for 2 turns.

[gold]Lock[/gold] extinguishes an Orb and prevents activation and settlement. Its value can still increase, and it can still move.

First play [gold]Tidal Gravity[/gold].
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step7_result:
Current Tide: [gold]{Tide}[/gold] · {TideState}
Current Waves: [gold]{Waves}[/gold]

A locked Orb shows thorns and a turn indicator.

Next you will test Trickle on the locked Tide.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step8_title: Raise the value of a locked Orb
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step8:
Tide is now locked.

Play [gold]Trickle[/gold]. Tide’s value will increase and it can move to the foreground, but it cannot activate.

A lock does not prevent value gain.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_task8: Play [gold]Trickle[/gold] and compare locked Tide’s value and active state.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step9:
Tide gained value but remains locked and inactive.

[gold]Renewal[/gold] grants {GrowthGain} Growth and locks Fire for 1 turn.

Play [gold]Renewal[/gold] to move Growth in front. When the Growth Orb settles, it increases the lowest-valued other Orb's value by the Growth Orb's value.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step9_result:
Tide: [gold]{Tide}[/gold] · {TideState}
Fire: [gold]{Fire}[/gold]
Growth: [gold]{Growth}[/gold]

Lock prevents activation and settlement, but still allows value increases.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_task9: Play the highlighted [gold]Renewal[/gold] and watch Growth and Fire.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step10_title: Growth settles into the lower-valued Orb
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step10:
Growth is active in front; the other two Orbs are locked.

Press [gold]End Turn[/gold]. The Growth Orb will increase the lowest-valued other Orb's value by the Growth Orb's value.

Locked Tide will not settle, but existing Waves can still help defend you.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_task10: Press [gold]End Turn[/gold] and watch which Orb's value increases.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step11:
Practice covered [gold]activation, foreground/background effects, settlement, Waves, Extra Settlement, Lock and Growth[/gold].

Hover cards, Orbs and Powers for help. After a win, you can choose compact nested tips.

Finish returns to the menu. Start your own run next; this lesson records no win or loss.
LIBRARIAN_TUTORIAL.practice_step11_resul:
The Growth Orb increased the lower-valued Fire Orb's value.

Current Fire: [gold]{Fire}[/gold]
Tide: [gold]{Tide}[/gold] · {TideState}
Growth: [gold]{Growth}[/gold]
Waves: [gold]{Waves}[/gold]

You can enter practice again from the main menu under RitsuLib → Librarian.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.reset_all_hint: Reset this profile's Librarian records and local settings. Main menu only; requires a second confirmation.
LIBRARIAN_SETTINGS.reset_all_confirm_bod:
Clear this profile's Librarian stats, ascension, discoveries and tutorial choices. Restore chapter progress to initial progressive unlocks, plus all local MOD settings and notice history.

Librarian-only run histories are deleted. Vanilla, other mods, saved runs and mixed multiplayer histories remain. Shared achievements and totals remain.

This cannot be undone.
